name: Clearskin — Genetic Purity Counterculture
description: Clearskin is a youth counterculture built around the deliberate rejection of all geneware modification — not from religious conviction but from a position that unmodified genetics are themselves a radical aesthetic and political statement in a world where modification is normalized. Members undergo regular genetic verification to confirm they carry no active geneware sequences, displaying their 'clean' status as a kind of credential. The movement has a complicated relationship with its own politics: some Clearskins are straightforwardly anti-modification, others are anti-corporate-modification specifically, and a vocal faction argues that choosing not to modify is simply one valid option among many. Internal arguments about who counts as 'clean' are constant.
cultural_impact: Clearskin has been accused by geneware communities of harboring biological purists and attracting people with more troubling motivations, a charge the movement's moderate faction actively fights. Their genetic verification practice has created a small market for independent (non-corporate) genetic testing services.
locations: The Clean Room (community space, Tier 3 South)
story_hooks: A Clearskin leader discovers they carry a dormant inherited geneware sequence from a grandparent — keeping it secret means betraying the movement's core credential, revealing it means expulsion.

The radical Clearskin faction is being recruited by a genuinely dangerous biological purity organization — the moderate faction needs help exposing the connection without destroying the entire movement.
A Clearskin member is pressured by their corponation employer to accept a mandatory geneware health modification — refusing means losing their job, accepting means losing their community.
